summary: Learn to shape business data into clear, accessible infographics. Practise layouts, charts and review checks; explore the course outline.
lede: Business infographics help communications, reporting and analysis professionals turn evidence into clear visual explanations. This training is for professionals who prepare visual updates, explain performance or translate complex information for colleagues and decision-makers. It covers defining a single message, selecting and labelling charts, arranging evidence in a clear visual hierarchy, and checking contrast, readability and source notes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare visual business updates, explain performance data or translate complex information for colleagues and decision-makers.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with business communication, reports or presentations is expected. Coding or programming is not required. You should be able to work with basic business information and use a spreadsheet and presentation software; advanced graphic-design experience is not required.
